Click the little bee to see its translation.

Click “Try translation” on the right.

请先填写并启用有效的翻译服务，再试译。: Configure and enable a translation service first.

Requests use your Volcengine Ark account quota.

在火山方舟控制台创建你的密钥。: Create your key in the Volcengine Ark console.
开通模型，复制 Model ID 或接入点 ID。: Enable a model and copy its model or endpoint ID.
填入 BeeK，保存并启用: Save and enable it in BeeK

点击按钮后，才会发送这句公开例句。\n重复试译优先使用本机缓存。:
Only this public sample is sent when you click.

如何获取 API Key…: How to get an API key…
相同内容优先复用已完成的翻译。\n所有翻译服务统一使用结果缓存（包括百度）。\n:
Reuse completed translations for repeated text.
All services use the same cache, including Baidu.
The cache stays in memory (up to 2 MiB) and is cleared on exit.
Changes apply immediately.
选择翻译引擎，再配置并启用。每个引擎的设置单独保留。\n不会自动切换服务；仅在你:
Choose an engine, then configure and enable it. Each service keeps its own settings.
BeeK never switches services automatically. Selected text is sent only when you request a translation.
模型 / 接入点 ID（留空用默认模型）: Model / endpoint ID (blank uses the default)
服务 API Key（本地服务可留空）: Service API key (optional for local servers)
提供流式翻译与单词详解。凭据只保存在本机。: Stream translations and get dictionary explanations. Credentials are stored only on this Mac.
无需 Key，初次使用默认启用。点击翻译后，选中文本经 Cloudflare 转: No key required; enabled by default for new users. Requested text is forwarded through Cloudflare to Baidu. The server does not retain source text or translations; the client can reuse cached results. Shared free quota is limited to 1,500 bytes per request. If busy or exhausted, switch to your own Baidu key or another service.
翻译为菜单中选择的语言。请填写自己的 App ID 和密钥。支持结果缓存。: Translates to the language selected in the menu. Enter your own app ID and secret. Result caching is supported.
翻译为菜单中选择的语言；单次最多 500 字节。需要明确源语言。邮箱为可选项。: Translates to the selected target language; up to 500 bytes per request. Set an explicit source language. Email is optional.
翻译为菜单中选择的语言。需要已运行的 LibreTranslate 服务（可使用: Translates to the selected target language. Requires a running LibreTranslate service (with Argos models). BeeK does not install or start it automatically.
翻译为菜单中选择的语言。请先开通对应翻译 API；保存配置本身不会发起网络请求。: Translates to the selected target language. Enable the service API first. Saving settings does not send a network request.
翻译会立即使用新的 Key，不需要重启。: New translations will use this key immediately. No restart needed.
配置文件损坏，原配置未更改。: The settings file is invalid. Your existing settings were not changed.
无法读取配置，原配置未更改。: Could not read settings. Your existing settings were not changed.
公共翻译服务尚未配置，请选择自己的百度 Key 或其他服务。: The shared service is not configured. Use your own Baidu key or another service.
未知翻译引擎，请重新选择翻译服务。: Unknown translation engine. Choose another service.
翻译服务配置过长。: Translation service settings exceed the length limit.
请先填写该翻译服务的 API Key / 密钥。: Enter an API key or secret for this service first.
百度翻译需要 App ID 和密钥。: Baidu Translate requires an app ID and secret.
MyMemory 需要明确的源语言代码，例如 en、ja；不能使用 auto。: MyMemory requires an explicit source language such as en or ja; auto is not supported.
远端翻译服务需使用 HTTPS；本机可使用 HTTP。: Remote services require HTTPS. Local servers may use HTTP.
服务地址不能包含账号、密码或片段。: The service URL cannot contain a username, password, or fragment.
选区为空或超过翻译长度限制。: Selected text is empty or exceeds the translation limit.
免费公共翻译单次最多 1500 字节，请缩短选区或切换自己的 Key。: The free shared service allows 1,500 bytes per request. Select less text or use your own key.
百度翻译单次最多支持 6000 字节，请缩短选区。: Baidu Translate allows 6,000 bytes per request. Select less text.
MyMemory 单次最多支持 500 字节，请缩短选区或切换服务。: MyMemory allows 500 bytes per request. Select less text or change services.
该引擎不使用此翻译协议。: This engine does not use this translation protocol.

无法创建翻译连接。: Could not create a translation connection.
翻译请求超时，请重试。: Translation timed out. Please try again.
翻译连接失败，请检查网络与服务地址。: Connection failed. Check your network and endpoint.
百度公共服务暂不可用，请在翻译服务设置中切换自己的百度 Key 或其他引擎。: The shared Baidu service is unavailable. Switch to your own key or another engine.
翻译服务认证失败，请检查凭据与区域。: Authentication failed. Check credentials and region.
翻译额度或频率受限，请稍后重试或手动切换服务。: Translation quota or rate limit reached. Try later or change services.
翻译服务响应超过大小限制。: The translation response exceeds the size limit.
翻译服务返回错误或无效结果，请检查配置及额度。: The service returned an error or invalid result. Check settings and quota.
译文为空或超过大小限制。: The translation is empty or exceeds the size limit.
翻译流包含无效或错误事件，请重试: The translation stream contains an invalid event. Please retry.
翻译未完整结束，请重试: The translation was incomplete. Please retry.
翻译流未完整结束，请重试: The translation stream ended early. Please retry.
